# Univariate Distribution

###Basic Notation

```{r}
# d-acro | PDF or PMF
# p-acro | CDF or Survival Fun (1-CDF)
# q-acro | Quantile
# r-acro | Simulating *pseudo* random number
#?dbinom
#?dgeom
#?dpois
#?dunif
#?dexp
```

### Binomial Distribution

```{r}
# Pick colors
colo <- c(
  rgb(32 / 255, 74 / 255, 135 / 255, 0.7),
  rgb(204 / 255, 0, 0, 0.7),
  rgb(200 / 255, 141 / 255, 0, 0.7),
  rgb(78 / 255, 153 / 255, 6 / 255, 0.7)
)

# Set parameters
pp <- c(0.5, 0.7)
nn <- c(20, 40)

# Plot PMF
plot(0:nn[1], dbinom(0:nn[1], nn[1], pp[1]),
     xlim = c(0, 40), ylim = c(0, 0.25),
     type = "b", lty = 3,
     xlab = "", ylab = "",
     col = gray(0.8), pch = 21, bg = colo[1])
lines(0:nn[1], dbinom(0:nn[1], nn[1], pp[2]),
      type = "b", lty = 3,
      col = gray(0.8), pch = 21, bg = colo[2])
lines(0:nn[2], dbinom(0:nn[2], nn[2], pp[1]),
      type = "b", lty = 3,
      col = gray(0.8), pch = 21, bg = colo[3])
lines(0:nn[2], dbinom(0:nn[2], nn[2], pp[2]),
      type = "b", lty = 3,
      col = gray(0.8), pch = 21, bg = colo[4])
grid()
legend("topleft",
       c("p = 0.5, n = 20", "p = 0.7, n = 20",
         "p = 0.5, n = 40", "p = 0.7, n = 40"),
       col = colo, pch = 19,
       bty = "n", cex = 0.8)
```

```{r}
#Plot CDF

# Plot CDF for different combinations of p and n
plot(stepfun(0:nn[1], c(0, pbinom(0:nn[1], nn[1], pp[1])), right = FALSE),
     xlim = c(0, 40), do.points = TRUE, verticals = FALSE,
     col = colo[1], pch = 19, main = "", xlab = "", ylab = "")

# Add second CDF line to the same plot
plot(stepfun(0:nn[1], c(0, pbinom(0:nn[1], nn[1], pp[2])), right = FALSE),
     do.points = TRUE, verticals = FALSE,
     col = colo[2], pch = 19, add = TRUE)

# Add third CDF line to the same plot
plot(stepfun(0:nn[2], c(0, pbinom(0:nn[2], nn[2], pp[1])), right = FALSE),
     do.points = TRUE, verticals = FALSE,
     col = colo[3], pch = 19, add = TRUE)

# Add fourth CDF line to the same plot
plot(stepfun(0:nn[2], c(0, pbinom(0:nn[2], nn[2], pp[2])), right = FALSE),
     do.points = TRUE, verticals = FALSE,
     col = colo[4], pch = 19, add = TRUE)

grid()

```

### Geometric Distribution

```{r}
# Pick colors
colo <- c(
  rgb(32 / 255, 74 / 255, 135 / 255, 0.7),
  rgb(204 / 255, 0, 0, 0.7),
  rgb(200 / 255, 141 / 255, 0, 0.7),
  rgb(78 / 255, 153 / 255, 6 / 255, 0.7)
)

# Set parameters
pp <- c(0.2, 0.5, 0.8, 1.0)
xmax <- 10

# Plot PMF
plot(1:(xmax + 1), dgeom(0:xmax, pp[1]),
     xlim = c(0, xmax), ylim = c(0, 1),
     type = "b", lty = 3,
     xlab = "", ylab = "", col = gray(0.8),
     pch = 21, bg = colo[1], xaxt = "n")
axis(1, 0:(xmax + 1), 0:(xmax + 1))
lines(1:(xmax + 1), dgeom(0:xmax, pp[2]),
      type = "b", lty = 3, col = gray(0.8),
      pch = 21, bg = colo[2])
lines(1:(xmax + 1), dgeom(0:xmax, pp[3]),
      type = "b", lty = 3, col = gray(0.8),
      pch = 21, bg = colo[3])
lines(1:(xmax + 1), dgeom(0:xmax, pp[4]),
      type = "b", lty = 3, col = gray(0.8),
      pch = 21, bg = colo[4])
abline(v = 0:(xmax + 1), col = "lightgray", lty = "dotted", lwd = par("lwd"))
abline(h = seq(0, 1, 0.2), col = "lightgray", lty = "dotted", lwd = par("lwd"))
legend("top", c("p = 0.2", "p = 0.5", "p = 0.8", "p = 1.0"), col = colo, pch = 19, bty = "n", cex = 0.8)
```

```{r}
# Plot CDF
plot(stepfun(1:(xmax + 1), c(0, pgeom(0:xmax, pp[1])), right = FALSE),
     xlim = c(0, xmax), ylim = c(0, 1),
     do.points = TRUE, verticals = FALSE,
     col.hor = colo[1], col.points = colo[1], pch = 19, main = "",
     xlab = "", ylab = "", xaxt = "n")
axis(1, 0:(xmax + 1), 0:(xmax + 1))

# Keep plotting additional CDFs
plot(stepfun(1:(xmax + 1), c(0, pgeom(0:xmax, pp[2])), right = FALSE),
     do.points = TRUE, verticals = FALSE,
     col.hor = colo[2], col.points = colo[2], pch = 19, add = TRUE)
plot(stepfun(1:(xmax + 1), c(0, pgeom(0:xmax, pp[3])), right = FALSE),
     do.points = TRUE, verticals = FALSE,
     col.hor = colo[3], col.points = colo[3], pch = 19, add = TRUE)
plot(stepfun(1:(xmax + 1), c(0, pgeom(0:xmax, pp[4])), right = FALSE),
     do.points = TRUE, verticals = FALSE,
     col.hor = colo[4], col.points = colo[4], pch = 19, add = TRUE)

# Reference lines
abline(v = 0:(xmax + 1), col = "lightgray", lty = "dotted", lwd = par("lwd"))
abline(h = seq(0, 1, 0.2), col = "lightgray", lty = "dotted", lwd = par("lwd"))

```

### Poisson Distribution

```{r}
# Pick colors
colo <- c(
  rgb(32 / 255, 74 / 255, 135 / 255, 0.7),
  rgb(204 / 255, 0, 0, 0.7),
  rgb(200 / 255, 141 / 255, 0, 0.7),
  rgb(78 / 255, 153 / 255, 6 / 255, 0.7)
)

# Set parameters
pp <- c(0.8, 1, 4, 10)
xmax <- 20

# Plot PMF
plot(0:xmax, dpois(0:xmax, pp[1]),
     xlim = c(0, xmax), ylim = c(0, 0.5),
     type = "b", lty = 3,
     xlab = "", ylab = "", col = gray(0.8),
     pch = 21, bg = colo[1])
lines(0:xmax, dpois(0:xmax, pp[2]),
      type = "b", lty = 3, col = gray(0.8),
      pch = 21, bg = colo[2])
lines(0:xmax, dpois(0:xmax, pp[3]),
      type = "b", lty = 3, col = gray(0.8),
      pch = 21, bg = colo[3])
lines(0:xmax, dpois(0:xmax, pp[4]),
      type = "b", lty = 3, col = gray(0.8),
      pch = 21, bg = colo[4])
grid()
legend("top",
       c(as.expression(bquote(mu == .(0.8))),
         as.expression(bquote(mu == .(1.0))),
         as.expression(bquote(mu == .(4.0))),
         as.expression(bquote(mu == .(10.0)))),
       col = colo, pch = 19, bty = "n", cex = .8)
```

```{r}
# Plot CDF
plot(stepfun(0:xmax, c(0, ppois(0:xmax, pp[1])), right = FALSE),
     xlim = c(0, xmax), ylim = c(0, 1),
     do.points = TRUE, verticals = FALSE,
     col.hor = colo[1], col.points = colo[1], pch = 19,
     main = "", xlab = "", ylab = "")

lines(stepfun(0:xmax, c(0, ppois(0:xmax, pp[2])), right = FALSE),
      do.points = TRUE, verticals = FALSE,
      col.hor = colo[2], col.points = colo[2], pch = 19)
lines(stepfun(0:xmax, c(0, ppois(0:xmax, pp[3])), right = FALSE),
      do.points = TRUE, verticals = FALSE,
      col.hor = colo[3], col.points = colo[3], pch = 19)
lines(stepfun(0:xmax, c(0, ppois(0:xmax, pp[4])), right = FALSE),
      do.points = TRUE, verticals = FALSE,
      col.hor = colo[4], col.points = colo[4], pch = 19)


grid()

```

### Uniform Distribution

```{r}
# Set parameters
a <- 0
b <- 1
xmid <- (b - a) / 2
ymx <- max(dunif(xmid, a, b))

# Graphical parameters
par(mfrow = c(2, 1), mar = c(0, 0, 0, 0))

# Plot PDF
curve(dunif(x, a, b), from = a - 2, to = b + 2, n = 500,
      type = "p", cex = 0.5, pch = 15,
      ylim = c(-0.05, 1),
      col = rgb(0.69019, 0.24313, 0.47843, 0.3),
      axes = FALSE, xlab = "", ylab = "")
abline(h = -0.015, lwd = 1, lty = 1, col = rgb(0, 0, 0, 0.4))
text(xmid, ymx, "1 / (b - a)", pos = 1, cex = 0.8)
segments(c(a, b), 0, c(a, b), ymx, lwd = 1, lty = 3, col = rgb(0, 0, 0, 0.4))
segments(c(a, b), 0, c(a, b), -10, lwd = 1, lty = 3, col = rgb(0, 0, 0, 0.4))
legend(a - 2, ymx / 2, expression(f[X](x)),
       col = rgb(0.69019, 0.24313, 0.47843, 0.3),
       pch = 19, bty = "n")
# Plot CDF
curve(punif(x, a, b), from = a - 2, to = b + 2, n = 101,
      lwd = 4, type = "l", col = rgb(0.69019, 0.24313, 0.47843, 0.3),
      ylim = c(-0.05, 1), axes = FALSE, xlab = "", ylab = "")
abline(h = -0.015, lwd = 1, lty = 1, col = rgb(0, 0, 0, 0.4))
text(c(a, b), 0, labels = c(a, b), pos = 1, cex = 0.8)
segments(c(a, b), 0, c(a, b), 10, lwd = 1, lty = 3, col = rgb(0, 0, 0, 0.4))
text(b + 2, 1, "1", pos = 1)
text(a - 2, 0, "0", pos = 3)
legend(a - 2, 0.5, expression(F[X](x)),
       col = rgb(0.69019, 0.24313, 0.47843, 0.3),
       lwd = 6, bty = "n")
```

### Exponential Distribution

```{r}
# Pick colors
colo <- c(
  rgb(32 / 255, 74 / 255, 135 / 255, 0.7),
  rgb(204 / 255, 0, 0, 0.7),
  rgb(200 / 255, 141 / 255, 0, 0.7),
  rgb(78 / 255, 153 / 255, 6 / 255, 0.7)
)

# Plot PDF
curve(dexp(x, 0.5), from = 0, to = 5,
      xlab = "", ylab = "",
      ylim = c(0, 1.6),
      lwd = 6, col = colo[1])
curve(dexp(x, 1.0),
      lwd = 6, col = colo[2],
      add = TRUE)
curve(dexp(x, 1.5),
      lwd = 6, col = colo[3],
      add = TRUE)
curve(dexp(x, 2.0), 
      lwd = 6, col = colo[4],
      add = TRUE)
grid()
legend("top",
       c(as.expression(bquote(lambda == .(0.5))),
         as.expression(bquote(lambda == .(1.0))),
         as.expression(bquote(lambda == .(1.5))),
         as.expression(bquote(lambda == .(2.0)))),
       col = colo, lwd = 6, bty = "n")
```

```{r}
# Plot CDF
curve(pexp(x, 0.5), from = 0, to = 5,
      ylim = c(0, 1),
      xlab = "", ylab = "",
      lwd = 6, col = colo[1])
curve(pexp(x, 1.0),
      lwd = 6, col = colo[2],
      add = TRUE)
curve(pexp(x, 1.5),
      lwd = 6, col = colo[3],
      add = TRUE)
curve(pexp(x, 2.0),
      lwd = 6, col = colo[4],
      add = TRUE)
grid()

legend("bottom",
       c(as.expression(bquote(lambda == .(0.5))),
         as.expression(bquote(lambda == .(1.0))),
         as.expression(bquote(lambda == .(1.5))),
         as.expression(bquote(lambda == .(2.0)))),
       col = colo, lwd = 6, bty = "n")

```
